title: Cloudflare CRM: simple working customers, contacts, deals and tasks pilot
objective: Build a simple, usable test CRM on one Cloudflare Worker + D1 with React UI. Prioritize working functionality and speed. Defer optional hardening and infrastructure additions until after real production.
deliverables: dedicated CRM account and D1; no unrelated account changes
single Worker with Access-verified identity and tenant-scoped records
create, list, edit, search and delete customers, contacts, deals and tasks
React/Vite UI built and deployed as Cloudflare Static Assets
simple Node tests, source CI and one native Wrangler deployment
preserve earlier G2 and do not merge historical Docker G3
live Chromium E2E after deploy using existing Access service token
acceptance: all changed paths are in the active packet and generated navigation is current
working CRUD for customers, contacts, deals and tasks
usable browser UI on desktop and phone, saved records survive refresh
GitHub CI builds the exact source and publishes a protected CRM app
defer advanced hardening and extra infrastructure until after real production
non_goals: deploy CRM while Cloudflare Access is not enabled or without accepted authorization rules
alter current main G2 architecture or delete currently accepted Rust/PostgreSQL sources
introduce containers, VM, external database, queue, AI, or a parallel auth service before necessity is shown
